notes:
Summary: Skyforge is a European fintech building customer-facing chat + doc search + fraud detection features. They're highly restrictive on data residency (EU-only), require BYOK (KMS) with key custody options, and need full audit logging to send to Splunk. Primary ask: Private VPC deployment with SSO (SAML) + SCIM provisioning for user sync and role assignment, plus RBAC surfaced in the Redwood Console/control plane so their IAM team can map to internal roles. They also want canary rollouts, model pinning, and automated fallback to smaller quantized variants when capacity constrained.

Quotes: "We can't ship data outside EU and keys must remain under our control" — Head of Infra. "Need proof we can emit audit events to our SIEM and that SCIM will mirror groups accurately" — IAM lead.

Practical: cost sensitivity moderate for inference-heavy reranking pipelines; latency SLOs 150ms p95 for chat paths, throughput 120 qps for embedding ingest. Interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching/quantization once POC proves baseline correctness.

Stubs: shared pricing deck and proposed SOW (drive links). Gmail thread contains procurement questions about support SLAs and indemnity.
requirements_summary: Must provision in customer VPC (EU region), support SAML SSO with metadata exchange and attribute mapping, SCIM for automated user/group provisioning and deprovisioning, RBAC in control plane (roles: admin, devops, analyst, readonly) with audit trail for role changes, BYOK via KMS/HSM (support both cloud KMS and external HSM with wrapping), audit log export to Splunk/ELK, data residency enforcement (no cross-region backups), SLA for uptime and incident escalation. POC acceptance criteria: successful SAML login + group-lookup via SCIM, RBAC enforcement on console and API, encrypted keys under customer control, and continuous export of audit events to customer's SIEM for 7 days.
rbac_model_requested: Role-based with 4 canonical roles (admin, infra, analyst, read-only), custom role support, token-level audit mappings
notes_short: Evaluation stage: security review heavy. Need SAML/SCIM + BYOK and audit integration proof. Legal & network are blockers.
pitch_notes: Emphasize unified control plane RBAC, out-of-the-box SCIM connectors, BYOK HSM flow, and audit log sinks. Offer 4-week EU PoC with pre-configured SAML metadata & temporary keys for validation.
